name: Finney's Crafthouse
tagline: Scratch-made American tavern fare, 30+ craft taps, and outdoor fire pit patio
description: Occupying the historic 1920s Dodge Brothers car dealership building in Old Towne Orange, Finney's Crafthouse blends industrial heritage with modern tavern comfort. Known for over 50 made-from-scratch American classics—including gourmet smash burgers, carnitas nachos, Bavarian pretzels with beer cheese, and truffle fries—paired with 30+ rotating California craft beers on tap and a vibrant beer garden patio equipped with cozy fire pits.
historicNote: Housed within the historic 1920s Dodge Brothers auto dealership showroom, featuring restored timber trusses, roll-up garage doors, and vintage industrial brickwork.

specials.title: Weekday Kickoff Happy Hour & Combo
specials.description: $5 craft draft beers, $7 handcrafted cocktails, and $15 Finney Burger + fries + pint combo at the bar.

specials.title: Taco & Tap Tuesday
specials.description: Baja Rockfish, Braised Carnitas, or Crispy Avocado Tacos ($4 each) with $5 California IPA pints.

specials.title: Midweek Flight Night & Flatbreads
specials.description: Build your own 4-pour craft beer flight ($12) paired with half-priced Margherita and Prosciutto flatbread pizzas.

specials.title: Thirsty Thursday Patio & Pints
specials.description: $5 draft beers during 3-5pm happy hour, followed by $2 off all draft handles around the outdoor fire pits.

specials.title: Friday Beer Garden Sunset Happy Hour
specials.description: $5 draft pints, $6 wines, and $8 appetizers (Truffle Fries, Bavarian Pretzels with beer cheese) around the outdoor fire tables.

specials.title: Weekend Craft Tap Takeover Feature
specials.description: Limited-release keg tappings from top West Coast breweries served alongside signature Carnitas Nachos and Smash Burgers.

specials.title: Sunday Game Day & Beer Buckets
specials.description: Watch sporting events on outdoor patio screens with $20 craft can buckets and $10 Hot Wing platters.

events.title: West Coast Brewer Spotlight & Keg Tappings
events.description: Showcase of rare seasonal IPAs and barrel-aged stouts with guest brewmasters in the outdoor fire pit beer garden.

researchMetadata.verificationNotes: Verified 204 W Chapman Ave location (historic Dodge Brothers dealership), operating hours (Sun-Thu 11am-9pm, Fri-Sat 11am-10pm), phone (714) 278-3010, and weekday Happy Hour 3-5pm ($5 drafts, $15 burger & pint combo).
